axes_source: Read from data/brands/clay.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #0A0A0A and the canvas #FFFAF0; contrast from the ink #0A0A0A on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #0A0A0A; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 6, 8, 12, 16, 24px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #0A0A0A reaches 19.03:1 on the canvas #FFFAF0, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
